description: Standing jobs: list the calling wallet’s standing jobs with state (pending_activation, active, completed, expired or cancelled), runs completed and failed, last result and next run, plus the wallet’s digests and routing rules. Optional state filter. POST /api/schedule-list. Standing jobs check and report: they run read-and-report Wever tools only and never move money, place orders or change state. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Every call carries X-Wever-Wallet-Proof bound to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route; a paid call adds Payment-Signature from the same wallet. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/standing-jobs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/standing-jobs/.
name: wever_schedule-list
title: List standing jobs
